steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: AO3 Weighting: Context is worth 15-25% of marks. Always link context to specific analysis, never just list facts. | Caution: Don't reduce poems to autobiography. Use biography to illuminate, not define meaning. | Never bolt context on: "This poem was written in 1917 during WW1. Owen shows..." Integrate context: "Owen's graphic imagery of 'gargling blood' reflects the brutal reality of trench warfare, challenging the patriotic lies told to families at home." | Top Tip: AO3 (context) is worth 15-25% of poetry marks depending on your exam board. Context must be integrated into your analysis — never bolt it on as a separate paragraph. Every context point should be linked to a specific quotation or technique. A single well-integrated context point outperforms three disconnected facts.
